environment.CARGO_PKG_DESCRIPTION: A toolchain for compiling textual syntax into Mech blocks.
Retained program execution, reactive coordination, and bytecode integration for Mech.
Backend-neutral planning and intermediate representations for resident Mech compute regions.
Math library for the Mech language
Comparison library for the Mech language
Logic library for the Mech language
Range library for the Mech language
Runtime abstraction layer for Mech execution backends.
Resident CPU and wgpu compute backends for Mech.

reuse_policy: A crate reuses its library only when every recorded Rust/manifest source under its manifest directory matches and none of its Mech dependencies rebuilt. All reused and rebuilt library hashes are verified.
